rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a 2BB/full blastocyst: blastocoel filling most of the embryo, loosely grouped ICM, and sparse/loose TE. Minor issues include calling it a Day 4 blastocyst despite the image/lab grade being more classically blastocyst-stage and limited comment on zona thinning/hatching status.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, BMI/lifestyle, and especially thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis in a clinically meaningful way.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with the implantation estimate appropriately adjusted downward for thin lining and endometriosis. Minor overstatement of embryo quality as 'good' for a 2BB and some uncertainty around Day 4 timing prevent a perfect score.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice: SET at age 31, caution with thin endometrium, no routine PGT-A after a single failure. Slight deviations include somewhat confident probability estimates and broad suggestions not tightly tied to guideline thresholds.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, lining review, cavity assessment, luteal support review, and consideration of FET if thin lining persists. Useful but not highly protocol-specific.
